the identification of the pathophysiologic basis of a new syndrome of adult-onset postprandial hypoglycemics.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
noninsulinoma pancreetogenous hypoglycaemia syndrome is a rare cause of hyperinsulinemic recurrent hypoglycaemic attacks.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this disorder is not an insulinoma, is not caused by a tumor, is not an insulin resistance state, is not a rare disorder, and is not a disorder that is best treated with medical therapy.
the noninsulinoma pancreetogenous hypoglycemias syndrome is a distinct entity, with a high likelihood of cure with distal pancreas resection.
patients with this syndrome have a diffuse form of islet cell disease that is amenable to surgical resection.
